name: Muramite Industrial: Yard
summary: A massive staging yard where raw Discord-tainted ore, arcane slag, and industrial materials enter the Muramite production pipeline.
description: The Industrial Yard is the entry point for all raw materials feeding the Muramite Dominion’s industrial machine. Ore carts rumble across Discord‑reinforced tracks, slave labor lines unload fissure‑tainted stone, and overseers direct shipments toward the Refinery and Foundry. The air is thick with dust, smog, and unstable energy. Muramite legionnaires guard the perimeter while Dragorn laborers toil under brutal conditions. Discord manifestations occasionally erupt from contaminated shipments.
